policies.title: Reference and amplitude interpretation
policies.proposed_position: Retain the existing 20-second immediately preceding clean baseline for descriptive event-relative optical amplitude and signed integral. Keep fixed native-union footprint, full sample requirement and saved event bounds.
policies.permitted_interpretation_if_admitted: A local optical change relative to that preceding baseline; known precursor, drift and support effects remain visible. Numerical valid status is not physiological acceptance.
policies.unresolved_or_prohibited_substitution: A replacement baseline is not proposed for adoption. Any alternate reference must first name its estimand, required support and known-signal/development comparison.

policies.title: Missingness and observation support
policies.proposed_position: Keep all detections in descriptive count/coverage/concurrency calculations independently of amplitude availability. Keep unavailable amplitude/integral values unavailable and negative finite amplitudes signed. Report both event counts and covered-support availability.
policies.permitted_interpretation_if_admitted: Finite-amplitude summaries describe only their explicitly identified subset. Missing amplitude alone does not invalidate native coverage or justify deleting initial recording exposure.
policies.unresolved_or_prohibited_substitution: No zero imputation, post-event fallback, silent complete-case substitution, or numerical availability threshold is proposed. For paired amplitude claims, expose both-state per-animal availability; a missing state leaves that metric contrast unavailable.

policies.title: Onset, duration and recovery
policies.proposed_position: Retain current saved-boundary descriptive onset/concurrency and native-versus-measurement timing diagnostics. Keep acquisition-start contact, ongoing-at-window-start, unresolved edges and recurrence separate.
policies.permitted_interpretation_if_admitted: Current sink onsets use saved, potentially refined StartSec; native-mask occupancy uses native support. Neither is a validated physiological onset or recovery measure.
policies.unresolved_or_prohibited_substitution: A frame-1-excluded onset diagnostic is a possible future sensitivity comparison, not an approved new primary rule. Physiological recovery needs a return reference, persistence, minimum observation and censoring policy before confirmatory release.

policies.title: Outcome hierarchy and admission
policies.proposed_position: Carry forward candidate primary sink occupancy and onset rate, required concurrency/availability, explanatory both-sign amplitude/integral/area/duration, and secondary sink composite. Keep response/calibration questions separate.
policies.permitted_interpretation_if_admitted: The original hierarchy remains proposed. Onset identity and eligible tissue-time remain essential admission conditions for their respective candidate primary outcomes.
policies.unresolved_or_prohibited_substitution: No primary outcome is demoted to pass a gate. Retain current sink composite unavailability for missing/wrong-direction contributions; surge composite remains undefined. Failure of onset validity requires an explicit hierarchy decision before final evaluation.

policies.title: C02 comparison and biological replication
policies.proposed_position: Use C02 as the worked planning example following the existing proposed order. For each admitted metric, propose one within-mouse isoflurane-minus-awake difference, followed by an equal-mouse mean of available paired differences.
policies.permitted_interpretation_if_admitted: A within-mouse state-associated contrast in this acquisition sequence. Pairing does not isolate anesthesia from order, wash-in, preparation or intensity-history effects.
policies.unresolved_or_prohibited_substitution: Priority, metric-specific eligibility, interval selection, repeated-session handling, inference, multiplicity and missing-pair sensitivity remain unapproved. Do not pool event rows, weight animals by event count, or substitute unpaired observations into the paired contrast.

admission_layers.meaning: Current numerical status, support and counts; may be established by arithmetic replay.
Source, exposure, tissue, calibration and preparation evidence for this recording and metric; successful analysis alone is insufficient.
Approved estimand and interpretation with relevant validation and comparison design; not implied by the other layers.

paired_estimand_proposal.eligible_pair_difference: d_i = Y_i,isoflurane - Y_i,awake, only when both states have admitted measurements for that metric
paired_estimand_proposal.across_mouse_summary: mean(d_i) across available eligible paired mice; equal mouse weight
paired_estimand_proposal.recording_rate_aggregation: If multiple valid intervals are approved within a state, combine nonoverlapping numerator/exposure ingredients before calculating rates; do not average rates with unequal exposure by accident. Repeat recordings/FOVs need a separate declared within-state rule.
paired_estimand_proposal.amplitude_summary: Propose per-state mean over explicitly reported finite event-relative amplitudes, conditional on observed events; also retain full event distribution, finite/total counts and missing-support coverage. No-event state has undefined event-amplitude mean, even when coverage is a valid zero.
paired_estimand_proposal.pair_missingness: Show all seven candidate mice with reason per missing metric/state; report N_pair per metric. Conditional paired estimate does not identify the full candidate-population effect without a justified missingness analysis.
